meta.rule: A question is only marked answered when the answer is computed from a committed file and that file is linked. Anything else says what is missing.

questions.question: Do the headline numbers on the live site reproduce from the committed data?
questions.answer: Yes, with two exceptions that are themselves findings.
questions.have: 19 independent checks: 16 agree, 0 unverified, 2 mismatch, 1 documented difference. The two mismatches are the ATS coin-flip statistic (IR-01), not the model numbers.
questions.missing: Nothing for these numbers. A price feed is still missing for any ROI claim.
questions.decision_needed: Accept the numbers as reproducible and fix the ATS statistic.

questions.question: Does the current model beat the closing line?
questions.answer: No. Walk-forward spread MAE is 10.391 against the market's 9.711 on the same 936 games, and the coefficient on the model after controlling for the close is -0.019 (p = 0.881).
questions.missing: Nothing for this question; a different model is a different question.
questions.decision_needed: Stop tuning this family of ratings models and spend the effort on timing data.

questions.question: Are same-game parlay legs independent?
questions.answer: No. QB passing yards and WR1 receiving yards correlate at +0.560 over 5,896 team-games, and the 2-leg joint is 0.336 against a product of 0.243 - 38% higher.
questions.missing: Historical prop prices, so the gap is a pricing fact, not yet a profit.
questions.decision_needed: Publish the pricing gap, and do not quote an independent-leg parlay ROI.

questions.question: Is a season win-loss record a repeatable skill?
questions.answer: No. Pythagorean luck does not carry to the next season (r = 0.024 over 842 team-seasons).
questions.missing: Nothing for the conclusion. Roster turnover would explain it but is not committed.
questions.decision_needed: Do not build a strategy on last season's record; if anything, fade it.

questions.question: Does any candidate strategy pass the ten gates?
questions.answer: No. 0 of 23 variants tested in this session and 0 of 9 published candidates.
questions.have: site/data/signals.json with a per-gate pass/fail and the exact failure reason.
questions.missing: A candidate that survives G1 (see Q-11).
questions.decision_needed: Do not fund, publish a pick, or build a ledger on top of these candidates.

questions.question: Is the repository internally consistent about its own provenance?
questions.answer: Mostly. Heavily documented, with a working independent recomputation, but the README quotes a model MAE of 10.38/9.70 while the site and the data show 10.391/9.711, and the ATS statistic is wrong in the way described in Q-01.
questions.have: This session's line-by-line review, 10 irregularities with sources.
questions.missing: An owner for README prose; the data pipeline regenerates the site, not the README.
questions.decision_needed: Assign the README fix and the ATS fix to one owner.

questions.question: Which starters are out, and who is the 2nd/3rd/4th-string replacement?
questions.answer: Not yet. The official injury report gives Out/Doubtful/Questionable but no depth rank.
questions.have: 108 players transcribed from the official Week 10 report, five games in full.
questions.missing: depth_charts_{season} (pos_rank) and snap_counts_{season} - both published upstream, neither committed, both unreachable from this sandbox.
questions.decision_needed: Run the download on a runner (SG-03) or accept that this question stays open.

questions.question: Did the backup actually play, and how much?
questions.answer: Not yet. Box scores show what a player did, not how many snaps he was on the field for.
questions.have: season snap totals in the upstream release, game-level snap counts in snap_counts.
questions.missing: snap_counts_{season} (third-party: Pro Football Reference) or pbp_participation.
questions.decision_needed: Pick one: snap counts for breadth, participation for precision. Do not use both as if independent.

questions.question: How much does the market move when a starter is ruled out?
questions.answer: Unknown and unmeasurable until prices are captured over time.
questions.missing: SG-02's timestamped capture; the injury feed dates the news.
questions.decision_needed: Fund the capture first; it is the only way this question ever gets an answer.

questions.question: What is a player prop actually priced at, historically?
questions.answer: Not in this repository. Accuracy is measured; price is not.
questions.have: Prop forecasts and MAE against realised box scores (data/derived/props.json).
questions.missing: Any licensed historical prop price. None is committed, and none is implied.
questions.decision_needed: Either license a price history or stop listing prop combos as a tested family.

questions.question: Can Gate G1 (point-in-time integrity) ever pass in the current design?
questions.answer: No. One un-timestamped closing line per game cannot evidence 'the price at bet time'.
questions.have: The gate text itself, and the data that fails it.
questions.decision_needed: Either fund the capture or restate G1 as 'closing-line settlement only'.

questions.question: What does 'top performing' mean for the rewards?
questions.answer: Undefined today. Highest ROI rewards luck; gates-passed-first rewards process.
questions.have: Ten published gates and a deflated-Sharpe threshold.
questions.missing: A written reward rule, a variant cap, and a statement that no pool is funded.

questions.question: Which sibling build is the product?
questions.answer: Seven static sites exist from parallel sessions (root, dashboard, nfl-lines, nfl-research, research-desk, quant-lab, origination-lab, skill-lab, origination). They disagree in places and none is marked canonical.
questions.have: COORDINATION.md records every session's claim and result.
questions.missing: A single canonical site and an archive rule for the rest.
questions.decision_needed: Adopt SG-01 and SG-07: one canonical site, the rest moved under /archive/.

questions.question: Is there a lawful, verified way to place a bet for this project?
questions.answer: Not verified. No operator account, jurisdiction, licence or limit has been checked.
questions.have: A statement on every page that this is research, not betting advice.
questions.missing: A jurisdiction decision and an operator's published terms, read by a human.
questions.decision_needed: Complete the execution checklist before any capital is discussed.

questions.question: Does any strategy make money after the hold?
questions.answer: Unknown. Every measured candidate loses, which is evidence but not proof of impossibility.
questions.have: 23 variants settled at the closing line, all negative or insignificant.
questions.missing: A timestamped price series, a licensed prop price, and a candidate that clears G1.
questions.decision_needed: None yet - this is the question the whole project exists to answer.

questions.question: How much of a team's week-to-week variance is injury-driven rather than noise?
questions.answer: Unknown. It needs the three missing feeds plus a variance decomposition.
questions.have: A variance decomposition for season records (luck.json).
questions.missing: Lineup continuity data at the player level.

questions.question: Would a correlated-parlay strategy be profitable at real, available prices?
questions.answer: Unknown. The pricing gap is measured; the available price is not.
questions.have: Measured joint vs independent pricing on 5,896 team-games.
questions.missing: Available same-game-parlay prices and the operator's correlation policy (terms change).
questions.decision_needed: Read the operator's current same-game-parlay terms; do not assume they ignore correlation.
